payload.body: You tend to revise an honest thought until it sounds harmless, then return to the same subject in a much blunter sentence later. The message stays in drafts, the point gets softened, and the real conversation remains unfinished. This usually reflects an early lesson that your questions, language, or opinions caused trouble. Say the plain version before you become too frustrated to say it calmly.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct Mercury can make the thought you are not supposed to say difficult to keep out of the conversation.
